rows.condition: Median time-to-first-touch exceeds 10 minutes during business hours.

source_lineage.sales_only_proof: 119 rows: one rooftop Dealer ID=21043; zero Service/Parts tokens in categorical columns; business-hours population (Originated After Hours=No)=76; Sales Rep aggregated in-memory, no names retained

rows.formula: median(Actual Response Time (Min) where Originated After Hours=No, numeric only)

baseline.label: Median time-to-first-touch ceiling (business hours)
baseline.source: Duane-supplied starter condition (catalog threshold_provenance)
baseline.definition: Median of numeric Actual Response Time (Min) within the native Originated-After-Hours=No population (VinSolutions Custom Reporting Leads). Blank response times remain missing, excluded from the median.

evaluation_detail.footnote: Median over the numeric Actual Response Time (Min) within the native Originated-After-Hours=No population; blank response times remain MISSING and are excluded from the median (missing is not zero). Operational target 10 min; triggers when median > 10.

baseline.label: Be-backs to fresh-ups ratio — inverted when > 1.0
baseline.source: Duane-supplied starter condition (catalog threshold_provenance); Gate 4B ratified Dashboard substitution
baseline.definition: Be Backs / Initial Visits from the Dashboard Visit Summary TOTAL (Initial Visits is the governed fresh-up denominator). Unbounded ratio: Be Backs may exceed Initial Visits so the value can be > 1.0. 'Inverted' (retention symptom) means the ratio exceeds 1.0. If Initial Visits=0 and Be Backs>0 it is an inverted/infinite firing signal not representable as a finite evaluated ratio; if both are zero the cell stays unresolved.

baseline.label: Unassigned-salesperson leads — zero tolerance

baseline.definition: Rate of accepted Leads rows with a BLANK Sales Rep over all accepted rows. All three accepted period files have zero blank Sales Rep rows, so the '>2 hours after creation' condition is false without an age calculation. Sales Rep name never persisted. Trigger any count > 0.

With zero blank Sales Rep rows no age determination is required and the ">2 hours after creation" condition is false. Operational target 0; triggers only on a proven unassigned-over-2h count > 0 (a nonzero blank count without row-level age evidence stays unresolved: unassigned_age_unproved).
